name: expense-assistant
description: A single-turn extraction agent with two jobs, told apart by what the turn carries: given a receipt photo, it reads the amount, date, merchant and category for an employee's claim; given a plain-language sentence, it reads the weekly amount and currency for a manager's team limit. Calls no other component and stores no business data of its own — expense-webapp sends it one turn and uses the structured reply to pre-fill a form. Exposed to the internet and gated on sign-in because expense-webapp calls it directly from the signed-in user's browser session.
